programme.desc: A sophisticated, overconfident hit man who always carries out his work in style transports his latest victim in plain sight on Halloween night.
programme.title: Into the Dark: The Body

programme.desc: S08 E03 — Mountain of Secrets The "Cold Justice" team investigates the mysterious death of a pregnant mother whose skull was found on a wooded mountain; with multiple suspects and conflicting stories, can they uncover the truth and get justice for her and her unborn child?
programme.title: Cold Justice

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Extraordinarily Out of the Ordinary Confront objects that make no sense; spot a spinning island in an Argentinian marsh, a colossal triangle stuck in the Arizona desert, mysterious multicolored pools across northern Ethiopia and a huge human figure hidden in the Australian outback.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Deep Blue Take a deep dive into watery enigmas; glide over a sunken Italian city; a unique underwater cemetery in the Florida Keys; a yellow brick road to nowhere in the depths of the North Pacific; puzzling rocky constructions off the coast of Australia.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Mass Graves Exhume chilling insights into ancient rituals, legendary warriors, and brutal deaths; investigate dozens of children's skeletons in Peru, find out if Amazon warriors once lived in Russia, and see what a UK cave full of butchered remains reveals.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: Dover Demon Investigating a strange creature seen in a wooded area of rural Massachusetts by three different people who all give similar descriptions.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S02 E04 — The Thomas Thorne Affair A discovery in the house leads Thomas to go down memory lane, but as Alison comes to realize, memory and reality don't always go hand in hand, especially when there are ghostly witnesses eager to tell their own version of events.
programme.title: Ghosts

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Coins, Curses, And Kings Getting insight into the last moments of England's King Richard III; deciphering a manuscript hiding taboo 15th-century knowledge; spotting indications of human sacrifice in Scotland; inspecting silver coins tied to turbulent times in Eastern Europe.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S13 E04 — San Sabas Deadly Harvest A town in Texas is stunned when a popular caretaker is found dead and a beloved, wealthy resident goes missing; with support from a concerned community, detectives uncover the deep-rooted secrets that led to murder.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S13 E05 — Big Island Blow Out When a young woman's body is pulled from the ocean off the Big Island, Hawaii, accusations threaten to destroy the local community; as tensions grow, a surprising discovery leads detectives to a devastating truth that no one saw coming.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S13 E10 — The Dark Days of Bucks County Historical Bucks County, Penn., is alarmed when several young men vanish one after the other within a week; with the support of residents, detectives unearth a ruthless murder spree in this seemingly picture-perfect farming community.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S13 E07 — Murder on Mirror Lake The quiet Sarasota neighborhood of Mirror Lake wakes up to a nightmare when a neighbor is found strangled to death; detectives believe it's the result of a long-held grudge against the silver tongued car salesman, but they turn out to be dead wrong.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S13 E01 — Boston's Little Girl Lost When an infant's body washes up on the shores of Deer Island, Mass., residents rally to find out who she is, and what happened to her; their unprecedented solidarity gets nationwide attention, helping police solve a heartbreaking mystery.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: The Mother and Daughter Killers Learn how influencer Mahek Bukhari and her mom, Ansreen, became the UK's first mother and daughter convicted of a double murder; see how the pair hatched a deadly plot when Hashim Ijazuddin tried to blackmail his much older ex-lover, Ansreen.
programme.title: Tik tok: murder gone viral

programme.desc: The Killing of Sania Khan Look at photographer Sania Khan's viral TikTok posts that detail the lies and abuse she suffered at the hands of her ex-husband Raheel Ahmad; learn how he exacted his jealous revenge by ambushing his former wife on the day she planned to escape.
programme.title: Tik tok: murder gone viral

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Adam Frasch Look inside the life of Dr. Adam Frasch, where nothing is as perfect as it seems; examine the crime scene where his wife, Samira, was found dead and discover why cops think it looks staged, then meet the witness who could blow their theory apart.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S01 E06 Two men go missing in bushland during a weekend getaway; detectives discover new details in a cold case involving a missing teenager.
programme.title: Missing Persons Investigation

programme.desc: S01 E02 Recounting the experiences of the victims of some of Britain's most prolific voyeuristic predators; reconstruction and interviews show how powerful men used their status to hide their sexual crimes.
programme.title: I'll Be Watching You

programme.desc: S04 E04 — James Ryan The suicide of a Maryland beauty queen leaves her loved ones in shock; but when her sister investigates, she finds evidence that suggests Sara has not died by her own hand; detectives set about proving who is guilty of her murder.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Caddo Parish, Louisiana Caddo Parish Correctional Center is struggling with a staffing shortage, the inmates outnumber the deputies by 180 to one; to ensure the safety of both inmates and staff alike, the Emergency Response Team springs into action.
programme.title: America's Toughest Jails

programme.desc: S02 E06 Detective Constable Tim Lamb and his team test the strength of their case after a seasoned drug dealer floors them with a surprise confession; his tearful claim of coercion may be real or may be an elaborate ruse to evade justice.
programme.title: Police: Suspect No. 1

programme.desc: S02 E06 The Hunters have a limited number of days to find the four remaining fugitives; they go to potential informants and look at CCTV footage.
programme.title: Hunted UK

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Swindled to Death (The Tina Caronna Story) Looking beneath the veneer of money, connections and fast cars that surrounded Tennessee couple Joe and Tina Corona; learning how secret lovers, shady investments and threats to reveal Joe's financial sins added up to the perfect recipe for murder.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E16 — Demonic Doll and More A Pennsylvania family is terrorized by a haunted doll; two friends witness a fleet of UFOs in the night sky; a man encounters the infamous Yowie in the Australian outback.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Florida Graveyard Shadows and More A shadow figure is spotted in a graveyard; a Hong Kong family is perplexed by a radiating light in the evening sky; a couple opens their arms to all things supernatural.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S02 E02 — A Basket Full of Ghosts and More A haunted basket mystifies a mother and daughter, a mythical creature is spotted in Wales and two intrepid investigators come face-to-face with Slenderman.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Middle

programme.title: The Middle

programme.title: The Middle

programme.title: Young Sheldon

programme.desc: S10 E2 — The Military Miniaturization Howard has a meeting with Colonel Williams, a representative from the Air Force Department of Material Command, about the gyroscope he invented with Leonard and Sheldon. Penny accidentally reveals that Bernadette is pregnant to their colleagues.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E3 — The Dependence Transcendence Tensions rise when the guys struggle to complete their Air Force project on time and are forced to work around the clock, leaving Sheldon fighting to stay awake. Penny and Amy attend a university gathering at the home of Bert the geologist.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E4 — The Cohabitation Experimentation When Amy's flat is flooded, she has to vacate it for five weeks while repairs are carried out and proposes a 'cohabitation experiment' with Sheldon. Howard and Bernadette have decided they don't want to know the gender of their unborn child.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E5 — The Hot Tub Contamination Things don't run smoothly as Amy and Sheldon's cohabitation experiment continues, forcing Leonard and Penny to intervene when the couple has an argument about the 'bathroom schedule'. Howard and Bernadette cancel their holiday plans when Bernadette feels unwell. They decide to have a secret stay-cation at home instead, but are disturbed by unexpected guests dropping by.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E6 — The Fetal Kick Catalyst Penny and Leonard attend a comic book convention, where Penny is surprised to learn that she has fans who enjoyed her performance in the movie Serial Ape-ist. Sheldon and Amy host a brunch at Penny's flat and, prompted by stress about the baby's arrival, Howard makes an impulsive purchase.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E7 — The Veracity Elasticity After the repairs are completed in Amy's flat, she lies to Sheldon by telling him that the work is still ongoing so they can carry on living together for a while longer.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E8 — The Brain Bowl Incubation Sheldon goes to great lengths to convince Amy that they should have a baby together after they successfully complete a scientific experiment using DNA samples from both of them.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S10 E9 — The Geology Elevation Sheldon can't contain his jealousy when he hears that his university colleague Bert the geologist has won a prestigious fellowship with an impressive grant.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
